key_insight: CP-Agent automates end-to-end crystal plasticity workflow execution from natural-language instructions by combining LLM reasoning with typed tools and external optimizers.
engineering_relevance: It reduces manual effort in parameter calibration, multi-step simulation orchestration, and workflow reproducibility for polycrystalline metal modeling.
method: ReAct-based LLM agent with tool selection and sequencing.
Harness engineering with typed tool schemas, dispatcher, and safety-bounded iteration loop.
Delegates numerical search/calibration to established optimizers while keeping reasoning traces visible.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports four case studies—316L calibration, copper benchmark validation, initial texture recovery, and Mg-Zn-Ca rolling texture reproduction—with correct execution sequences and physically interpretable outputs across repeated runs.
watch_item: Performance still depends on tool quality, prompt/task specification, and bounded iteration settings, so robustness and failure modes should be checked in new workflows.
paper_title: CP-Agent: A Harness-Engineered Agent for Crystal Plasticity Simulation Workflows
